subject: Update a dataframe after press a button

messages.author: 3318903e6722e885
messages.subject: Update a dataframe after press a button
parts:
Hi everyone,

Im having a little trouble using Shiny. I want to get a text and when user presses a button, one line is inserted in the main dataframe. And I want to show it in real time.

The problem is how should I do to show the dataframe at every moment the user presses a button? I tried to use the actionbutton, but with no sucess, because it's updated only when two lines are inserted. And both lines are inserted simultaneously. Can anyone help me with it?

I'm using the following code:

################### Server ###################

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

Data<<-data.frame(nome=NA)

addline<-function()
{
Data<-data.frame(Data,input$txt)
return(Data)
}

observe(
{
if(input$send==0)
return()
isolate(
{
Data<<-addline()
})
}
)

output$Table <- renderTable({
if(input$send)
{
Data
}
  })
  
})

################### UI ###################

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  headerPanel("Testing the input function"),

  sidebarPanel(
    textInput("txt", "Put your text here",'Text'),
br(),
actionButton('send','Send')
),

  mainPanel(
    tableOutput("Table")
  )
))
